claim: The treestock -> Treesmith funnel is DEAD, measured twice: 3,132 outbound clicks over six months produced 1 app-store click ever, and 0 in the last 30 days while traffic grew 64%.

body.status: DEAD, measured twice (DEC-241, DEC-325). Re-measured 2026-08-27 on the pre-registered date: 30d = 2,044 outbound clicks sitewide, 9 visitors to /treesmith.html, 0 to either app store; 6mo = 3,132 clicks, 1 App Store click ever. Traffic grew 64% while store clicks went 1 -> 0. Tags verified live first, so the zero is real. The blocks stay (free and honest) but they are decoration. Propose NO funnel, CTA-placement or /treesmith.html conversion work.
body.drip_email: DEC-240 / DAL-173: send_treesmith_intro.py mails the intro to each NEW treestock subscriber 7 days after signup, once. Nightly 23:30 UTC, a logged no-op until /opt/dale/data/treesmith-intro-enabled exists (Benedict approves the copy first).
